tool.title: Tool name
tool.description: Calculator to run, for example calculate_net_salary, get_kr_holidays, check_kr_business_day, calculate_severance_pay, calculate_jp_take_home. Run once with 'List tools' on to get every tool name and its argument schemas (free).

arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Arguments for the tool, as JSON. Example for calculate_net_salary: {"salary": 3500000}. Amounts are in the country's currency (KRW for Korea).

calls.title: Batch calls (optional)
calls.description: Run up to 50 calculations in one run: [{"tool": "get_kr_holidays", "arguments": {"year": 2027}}, ...]. When given, 'Tool name' and 'Arguments' are ignored.

listTools.title: List tools (free)
listTools.description: Output the full tool catalog with each tool's input schema instead of calculating. Not charged.
